title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - Vehicle
description: Self-propelled transport device, along with any attachments (e.g. trailers), that is a legal user of the transportation network (s4auto:Vehicle, subclass of s4auto:TrafficParticipant; Source: ISO/TS 19091:2019). Examples of vehicle kinds are car, truck, public transport and two-wheeler. The main IoT device considered in the vehicle is the s4auto:OnBoardUnit (see AutomotiveDevice).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Vehicle'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. WGS84 position, modeling s4auto:Position / s4auto:GeoPosition.

coordinates.description: Property. Coordinates of the Point, in WGS84 [longitude, latitude] order.

heading.description: Property. Orientation of the horizontal velocity vector (s4auto:Heading), in degrees.

speed.description: Property. Magnitude of the velocity vector (s4auto:Velocity3d), in m/s.

acceleration.description: Property. Magnitude of the acceleration vector (s4auto:Acceleration3d), in m/s^2.

yawRate.description: Property. Vehicle rotation rate around the z-axis centred on the empty-loaded vehicle's centre of mass (s4auto:YawRate), in degree/s.

curvature.description: Property. Curvature of the vehicle trajectory, as the inverse of the vehicle turning-curve radius (s4auto:Curvature), in 1/m. Positive values indicate a turning curve to the left of the driver.

vehicleKind.description: Property. Kind of vehicle, as defined by ISO 3833 (s4auto:*Vehicle).

wmiNumber.description: World Manufacturer Identifier (WMI) code, assigned according to ISO 3779 (s4auto:WMInumber).

vds.description: Vehicle Descriptor Section (VDS), assigned according to ISO 3779 (s4auto:VDS).

vehicleHeight.description: Property. Height of the vehicle measured from the ground to the highest point, excluding antennas, in metres (s4auto:VehicleHeight).

vehicleLength.description: Property. Length of the vehicle, in metres (s4auto:VehicleLength).

vehicleWidth.description: Property. Width of the vehicle, excluding side mirrors, in metres (s4auto:VehicleWidth).

vehicleMass.description: Property. Mass of the empty-loaded vehicle, in kg (s4auto:VehicleMass; ISO 1176 clause 4.6).

wheelBase.description: Property. Perpendicular distance between front and rear axle of the vehicle (s4auto:WheelBaseVehicle), in metres.

turningRadius.description: Property. Smallest circular turn (U-turn) the vehicle is capable of making, in metres (s4auto:TurningRadius).

numberOfOccupants.description: Property. Number of occupants in the vehicle (s4auto:NumberOfOccupants).

driveDirection.description: Property. Direction in which the vehicle is moving (s4auto:DriveDirection).

embarkationStatus.description: Property. Whether the vehicle (e.g. public transport, truck) is under the embarkation process (s4auto:EmbarkationStatus).

exteriorLights.description: Property. Status of the exterior light switches of the vehicle (s4auto:ExteriorLights). TRUE indicates the corresponding switch is on; it does not indicate whether the lamp is alight.

vehicleRole.description: Property. Role played by the vehicle at a point in time (s4auto:VehicleRole).

vehicleAcceleration.description: Property. Whether the vehicle's horizontal speed is increasing or decreasing (s4auto:VehicleAcceleration).

turningDirection.description: Property. Direction in which the vehicle is turning (s4auto:TurningDirection).

itineraryPath.description: Property. Ordered list of waypoints forming the vehicle's planned itinerary (s4auto:ItineraryPath, composed of s4auto:Position values).

stabilityLossProbability.description: Property. Estimated probability of loss of stability, 0 (stable) to 50 (total loss of stability); 63 means unavailable (s4auto:StabilityLossProbability).

steeringWheelAngle.description: Property. Steering wheel angle of the vehicle, in the ISO 8855 vehicle coordinate system, in degrees (s4auto:SteeringWheelAngle).

vehicleAutomationLevel.description: Property. SAE J3016 driving automation level: 0 (no automation) to 5 (full automation) (s4auto:VehicleAutomationLevel).

precipitationIntensity.description: Total rainfall during one hour per square metre, in mm/h (s4auto:PrecipitationIntensity).

temperature.description: Air temperature around the vehicle, in degrees Celsius (s4auto:Temperature).

vehicleEnvironment.description: Property. Entities and conditions present in the area around the vehicle (s4auto:VehicleEnvironment).

platoonRole.description: Property. Role the vehicle assumes in a platoon (s4auto:PlatoonRole).

platoonAutomationLevel.description: Property. Level of automation of the vehicle while platooning, per the ENSEMBLE project (s4auto:PlatoonAutomationLevel).

platoonVehicleState.description: Property. State of the vehicle with respect to platooning (s4auto:PlatoonVehicleState).

platoonPosition.description: Property. Index of the vehicle in its platoon, starting from 0 (leader) up to N (trailing vehicle) (s4auto:PlatoonPosition).

vehicleParkingState.description: Property. State related to the parking phases of the vehicle (s4auto:VehicleParkingState).

platoon.description: Relationship. The Platoon this vehicle is currently a member of, if any (inverse of s4auto:Platoon saref:consistsOf Vehicle).

trailer.description: Relationship. The Trailer(s) attached to this vehicle (s4auto:Vehicle saref:consistsOf Trailer).

dangerousGoods.description: Relationship. The kind(s) of DangerousGoods carried by this vehicle, if any (s4auto:Vehicle saref:consistsOf DangerousGoods).
